invariants.text: Employee.employee_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Employee.department_id must reference an existing Department.department_id
Department.department_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
An employee must belong to exactly one department.
A department can have zero or more employees.
When an employee is created, their department_id must reference an existing department.
When a department is deleted, all employees belonging to that department must be removed or the deletion must be prevented.
The list of employees for a department must include only employees whose department_id matches the given department_id.
